messages.text: I closed the card I paid with yesterday. Can you send this refund to my new card instead?

I can’t send the refund to a different card; refunds can only go to the order’s original payment (refund-policy/v2/payment). The BRL 77.90 refund was already recorded against that original payment, with receipt R-00000001. The card issuer handles any credit to a closed card, and the shop can’t promise where or when it will appear (refund-policy/v2/payment).
